headings.strategy: Expressive and modern. Use tracking-tight for large headings to maintain a cinematic and professional feel.

body.strategy: Clean, highly readable text for node descriptions, toolbars, and metadata.

mono.strategy: Use for technical details, timestamps, shot numbers, and tags inside nodes for a tech-forward look.

visual_enhancers.shadows: In dark mode, rely on 1px borders (e.g., border-zinc-800) and very subtle ambient shadows (shadow-xl shadow-black/50) to separate elevated panels from the canvas. Avoid heavy, soft drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For floating toolbars, use a dark glass effect: bg-zinc-900/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-zinc-800.
visual_enhancers.selection_states: High-contrast outlines (ring-2 ring-blue-500) for selected nodes. Nodes on hover should translate slightly (-translate-y-0.5) with a border brightness increase.
visual_enhancers.canvas_background: Implement a subtle dot or grid pattern on the canvas (e.g., bg-dot-white/[0.05]) to give users a sense of scale and infinite space.

toolbar.layout: Floating panel, center-bottom or middle-left. Pill-shaped or sharply rounded (rounded-xl), densely packed icons with tooltips.
toolbar.style: bg-zinc-900/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-zinc-800 shadow-2xl p-2 flex gap-2

nodes.general: All nodes should have rounded-lg or rounded-xl corners, border border-zinc-800, overflow-hidden.
nodes.frame_group: Large container nodes acting as 'Scenes'. They should have a semi-transparent background (bg-zinc-900/40), a dashed or solid colored border (e.g., border-zinc-700), and a bold Manrope heading in the top-left corner.
nodes.media_image: Frameless or thin-framed image tiles (Figma moodboard style). Images must use object-cover, rounded-md, with no awkward cropping.
nodes.character_setting: Card with a thumbnail image on top, followed by IBM Plex Sans title and JetBrains Mono tags (e.g., INT. DAY).
nodes.comment: Sticky note aesthetic but adapted for dark mode. Use a very dim tinted background (e.g., dark blue/yellow tint: bg-blue-950/30) with a left color bar.
nodes.edges: Smooth bezier or step paths. Stroke should be zinc-600. When selected, stroke changes to blue-500.

grids_and_layouts.canvas_layout: Full viewport w-screen h-screen relative layout. Toolbars and property sidebars are absolutely positioned over the canvas with z-50.
grids_and_layouts.node_layout: Inside 'Frame/Group' nodes, media images can be tiled using a grid layout (grid-cols-2 or grid-cols-3) to mimic a moodboard seamlessly.
grids_and_layouts.sidebar: If editing a node, slide in a properties panel from the right: w-80 bg-zinc-900 border-l border-zinc-800 h-full p-4.

motion.interactions: Use Framer Motion or equivalent for smooth pan/zoom easing. Toolbar actions should have scale-95 on tap and scale-105 on hover.
motion.transitions: Node selection and border color changes must transition smoothly (transition-colors duration-200).

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (toolbar buttons, nodes, canvas, zoom controls) MUST have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="canvas-zoom-in"').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has a gradient scrim or text-shadow. Normal text against #18181b or #27272a must be WCAG AA compliant (#a1a1aa or lighter).

libraries_and_steps.canvas: Use standard infinite canvas libraries like React Flow. If custom, implement zoom/pan with d3-zoom or react-zoom-pan-pinch.
libraries_and_steps.icons: Use lucide-react for all toolbar and UI icons.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Redesign the Canvas page (/projects/:id/canvas) to look like a premium Figma/FigJam board in dark mode.
instructions_to_main_agent.features: Implement drag/move/select, smooth zooming (fit-to-screen), and node connections. The core addition is the 'Frame' node, which acts as a visual container grouping other nodes (like Figma frames).
instructions_to_main_agent.aesthetic: Strictly stick to the dark theme (zinc-950 canvas, zinc-900 panels) with 1px border-zinc-800 to separate elements. No heavy shadows.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Ensure all nodes, edges, and controls have stable data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Do not use Shadcn 'Card' for the nodes if it enforces padding; nodes need to be edge-to-edge for media images. Build custom raw div nodes with absolute layout for React Flow (or equivalent).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop'. Use layers, subtle borders, and precise spacing.
Never use pure black or pure white unless for extreme contrast elements. Stick to the zinc scale.
Ensure the infinite canvas does not trap scroll uncontrollably; use standard spacebar+drag or middle-click panning.
All modals, toolbars, and popovers should have transparent blurred backgrounds (glassmorphism) without full transparency. (e.g., bg-zinc-900/80 backdrop-blur-md).
Missing placeholder images MUST use the provided URLs from image_urls, never text placeholders.
